audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits: Vex bullies the weak early Fizz, Fizz owns 6 and first item via untargetability plus shark, Vex reasserts at two items by tracking the E cooldown. Content layer states this correctly; 52.64% WR over 2027 games.

Spikes accurate and correctly named (Playful/Trickster, Chum the Waters, Urchin Strike, Seastone Trident): level 5 E-rank flip, level 6 shark kill spike, first-item one-combo, two-item Vex pick window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart blanket 'Skill' on all 7 rows while content/packet say Vex 1-4/5, Fizz at 6 and first item, Vex at 2+ items. Cooldowns field had no digit. Two Do's/Don'ts bodies pasted from tradeGood/tradeBad. Missing interactions now stated: Playful/Trickster (and shark knockup) denies Vex's own R dash window, and Seastone Trident's auto-reset wind-up is the step-back tell.
audit.why: E untargetability (16-8s) dodges Vex R/W burst; W is flagged autoReset; both from Riot kit text.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to content with grounded whys; E 16/8s and R 120/100/80s added; bleeds replaced with title-matched bodies.

edits.before: Q-poke the last-hits — the accelerating bolt chips from a deceptive range and Gloom marks tax every connect.
edits.after: Fizz is one of the weakest short-ranged openers — Q-poke his last-hits from 1200 range with total impunity.

edits.before: W online: the shield-fear pulse means anyone who dashes onto you regrets the itinerary.
edits.after: W online: his 550-range Urchin Strike arrives feared into your shield-pulse — he cannot trade yet.

edits.before: Full kit: E-mark into Q-fear is your trade engine — every passive proc is crowd control he scheduled for you.
edits.after: You still out-range and out-trade him at 3 — and every Playful hop he burns feeds your passive's mark.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — mark-and-bolt every wave contact; the fear windows zone harder than the damage.
edits.after: At 4 you still bully, but rank-3 E is one point away — land your poke now and start shortening the leash.

edits.before: Shadow Surge online — any skirmish in missile range is now your business; the reset execute travels.
edits.after: His E-untargetable hop dodges your R and W, then the shark one-combos — this window is his; hold Zhonya's.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the full marked rotation chunks half bars and fears the answer. Force the gloom war.
edits.after: First-item AP plus shark one-combos you through fear timing — fight only after he wastes his 16-8s E.

edits.before: Late Vex is anti-engage incarnate: their dive feeds your fears, your R feeds on their deaths.
edits.after: Track his E cooldown — once it is down, R and W burst delete a Fizz with no other way out of the fight.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Check it before every step-up. - W Personal Space is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Fizz Playful / Trickster (E): 16s at rank 1, 8 at max — the untargetable hop dodges your whole combo; bait it before spending burst. - Chum the Waters: 120/100/80s. W Personal Space is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. The ult answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: Urchin Strike is a targeted dash — it cannot miss, so meet it with the pulse: he arrives feared and his W bleed never gets to stack.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Seastone Trident is an auto-reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is your step-back cue; chase with fear down and the combo lands whole.
